name: Friends of Animals - Spay/Neuter Certificates
neighborhoods: NYC + nationwide via participating vets (use for feral-friendly clinics)
notes: Sells low-cost spay/neuter CERTIFICATES redeemable at participating vets - useful when ASPCA/Toby/HSNY appointments are booked. IMPORTANT for feral cats: only use a clinic experienced with ferals (their Feral-Friendly Veterinarians page). Intake: Buy discounted spay/neuter certificates online
